title: Recall or Relearn? A Mixture of In-Context Experts for Recurring Concept Drift
abstract: arXiv:2610.36585v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are being applied to Web data streams such as network intrusion detection, where they adapt by updating the labelled rows of their context without retraining. When a past concept returns after leaving the context, a TFM faces a recall-or-relearn decision between restoring stored rows of the concept and relearning it from new labels. We propose MICE (Mixture of In-Context Experts), a training-free learner that cuts the stream into segments at detected changes. It merges a closed segment into a stored context when the TFM's estimated additional error on the segment is within a tolerance, under a capacity limit on stored contexts. A fast level weights the stored contexts and first-in-first-out (FIFO) windows by the log-loss of their predictions on the last labelled batch. translated_title: 回忆还是重学？用于复发性概念漂移的上下文专家混合方法
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型（TFMs）正被应用于网络入侵检测等网络数据流场景，它们通过更新上下文中已标注的数据行来适应变化，而无需重新训练。当一个过去的概念在离开上下文后再次出现时，表格基础模型面临“回忆还是重学”的决策：是恢复存储的该概念的数据行，还是从新标注中重新学习。我们提出了MICE（上下文专家混合，Mixture of In-Context Experts），这是一个无需训练的学习器，它在检测到变化时将数据流切分为片段。当表格基础模型对某片段估计的额外误差在容忍度范围内时，它将该已关闭的片段合并到存储的上下文中，同时对存储上下文的数量施加容量限制。一个快速层级根据存储上下文和先进先出（FIFO）窗口在最近一批标注数据上预测的对数损失来对它们进行加权。我们证明，在纯存储上下文和边际条件下，该快速层级在期望精度上相对于重学习获得了标准化……
tldr: 提出无需训练的MICE方法，通过在检测到概念漂移时切分数据流并维护多个存储上下文，让表格基础模型在历史概念重现时能够自适应地在“回忆”旧上下文与“重学”新标注之间做出决策，从而更好地应对复发性概念漂移。
en_tdlr: MICE is a training-free mixture of in-context experts that segments data streams at detected changes and adaptively decides between recalling stored contexts and relearning from new labels, enabling tabular foundation models to handle recurring concept drift.
